comments.text:
You can check out our review video on Acko here for more insights - https://youtu.be/Eg80QXSjEtI?si=Tky7ZNJCW4kHuisZ

Regarding the Acko Platinum plan (their top-tier option), here are the key points:
Maternity Expenses: The plan does not cover maternity expenses.
Restoration of Sum Insured: The restoration benefit applies only for the treatment of different illnesses. If you are hospitalized or treated for the same illness again within the same year, the sum insured will not be restored. Instead, you will need to use the remaining balance of the base sum insured, if any is left.

If you have specific requirements, our advisory team can help you compare plans and choose the one that best suits your needs - https://ditto.sh/uxv8tf
